title: Release audit: `SENSITIVE_MARKERS` is English/Russian only. French/Spanish phrases such as `cré
summary: Localize the sensitive-operation marker set for all supported languages, including multi-word terms, and test that these phrases never become `say` and only point to the explicit command.
requirements: `SENSITIVE_MARKERS` is English/Russian only. French/Spanish phrases such as `crée un projet`, `crear un proyecto`, `définir le mot de passe` or `cambiar la configuración` are not refused or pointed to explicit commands; they fall through to `say` and are sent to the engine's project agent. The explicit-action guarantee is therefore not enforced for languages the session now accepts.
